title: ws-chat-send (app to server)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

client_id.description: Chosen by the app (at most 100 characters). Sending the same client_id again returns the stored chat_message to the sender only.

text.description: Trimmed by the server; 1 to 500 Unicode characters afterwards. @name tokens are resolved to mentions.

description: A member sends a chat message to a run or Session. Non-members get error forbidden, bad text or client_id gets bad_request, more than 2 messages/s (burst 5) per user gets rate_limited. Needs together_v1.
